notes:
CRM notes: mid-market PLG company building an in-product assistant and support augmentation. Primary ask: predictable latency and cost for heavy chat workloads plus embeddings for search. Initially tried hosted_api for quick iteration — liked the SDK and streaming. Now pushing to Dedicated for production: want reserved GPU pools, VPC peering, and strict audit logs.

POC scope (agreed): 14-day Dedicated POC in us-east-1, small canary (5% traffic from beta users) -> ramp to 30% if p95 latency < 300ms and error rate <0.5%. Canary routing plan: route by user cohort via routing policy tied to user_id hash; telemetry surfaced in Redwood Console.

Fallback / resilience plan: primary Dedicated cluster (us-east-1) -> fallback to hosted_api (lower-cost model variant) if queue depth or pod failure detected; secondary failover to eu-west-1 region for read-only features (embeddings) only. Model variants: prefer quantized 8-bit variant for cost-sensitive traffic, full fp16 model for priority queries. Rollback plan: automatic rollback trigger if canary p95 increases >2x baseline or NPS of generated responses drops on eval prompts; automated snapshot of KV cache + immediate traffic shift to hosted_api fallback.

Success metrics for POC: p95 latency (chat) <300ms, embedding p50 <60ms, 99.9% availability during business hours, token unit cost target < $0.24 per 1k tokens for typical session mix.

Procurement & pricing: finance wants a 12-month committed price or discounted hourly cap. Asked for a term sheet by 2026-03-17. AE note: "Pricing flexibility is the ask — they will go with Dedicated if cost delta vs hosted is <30% with SLA."

Security notes: SSO via Okta required, KMS integration mandatory, retention controls for support transcripts, legal flagged data residency for EU customers (must pin certain datasets to eu-west region). Legal asks additional audit log retention >2 years.
